There were five abstentions.”; on 2026-10-07, Deutsche Welle reported “Rausch was elected speaker with 48-29 votes, though just 44 votes for him would have resulted if only his party (39 seats) and the populist BSW (five seats), which had pledged to back him, had voted in his favor.”.
